name: Cestel d.o.o.
zag_role: Industrial partner on bridge weigh-in-motion work
description: SiWIM grew out of the weigh-in-motion research ZAG has run since the 1990s. Cestel supplies and operates the systems, and is a partner alongside ZAG in the BRIDGITISE doctoral network and on the Tomačevo bridge installation.
history: Cestel d.o.o. is at Špruha 32 in Trzin and states more than thirty years of experience in bridge weigh in motion measurement, traffic analysis and bridge assessment. Its product is SiWIM, presented as the first fully portable high speed weigh in motion system, which uses strain gauge sensors to collect data on heavy goods vehicles and on the bridge at the same time. The system measures gross vehicle weight, axle loads, axle spacing and speed, can be installed in less than a day without closing the road, and delivers data through web applications. The International Society for Weigh in Motion records that Cestel introduced SiWIM in 1999. The system is used for maintenance planning, for vehicle preselection in enforcement, and for bridge assessment.
